commits.author: sepantapouya
commits.subject: Icons: audit fixes — clipping, duplicates, centring, ambiguous shapes
details: An automated pass rasterised every icon and checked clipping, centre of
mass, ink weight, bold rendering and duplicates.
- podcast, fog and police-badge no longer cross the frame
- cog becomes a real eight-tooth gear (it matched nut), bleach gains the
standard diagonal lines (it matched triangle)
- a shift() helper moves a whole icon in every variant; high-heel, gold,
skateboard, garland, bat, shoe, service-bell, rice-plate, bridge,
fireplace, histogram, chart-waterfall, bar-chart and fog are now centred
- ping-pong, cutting-board and ney are redrawn so they no longer read as
search, battery and ruler
The composite matcher now takes the last </g>, so shifted bases compose.

commits.author: sepantapouya
commits.subject: Icons: prune meaningless composites; 1699 icons
details: Composites now come from an explicit list of sensible badges per base
instead of every badge on every base: gift keeps clock, check and star
but loses search and sync, heart keeps only plus/minus/check/x, file
keeps all fourteen. 511 low-value composites go, 375 remain, so they
make up about 22% of the set. Counts in READMEs and docs, a changeset
and the Figma plugin are updated.

commits.author: sepantapouya
commits.subject: Docs: calmer, higher-contrast homepage hero
details: Drop the rotating headline word (its width changes made the line jump
and the gradient text flicker), the coloured aurora and the pointer-lit
tile pattern, and the light beam around the product frame. The hero
now sits on a faint neutral grid, the accent is a solid brand colour,
and the badge, metrics and chips use opaque surfaces so text and the
product mock keep full contrast. Count-up, tilt, spotlight, marquee
and reveal motion stay.

commits.author: sepantapouya
commits.subject: Docs: enterprise homepage hero with motion and micro-interactions
details: New centered hero: aurora light, a kashi (khatam) tile pattern that
lights up under the pointer, a headline whose last word rotates through
organisation, bank, store, startup and government, a badge linking to
the icon set, factual version/licence/a11y pills, and a metrics strip
that counts up on view. The product mock tilts slightly in 3D, has a
light beam running round its border and Persian-feature chips floating
around it (Jalali date, IBAN, plate, contrast).
Across the page: a scroll progress bar, blurred reveal on scroll,
pointer spotlight on cards, a marquee for the tech stack, a shine on
the main button and a staggered pop when the icon style changes. All
motion is off under prefers-reduced-motion, and pointer effects only
run on fine pointers.

controls; icon cards open /docs/icons/<name>/, which also gets the style
picker. The chosen style travels in ?v=. The install and usage guide
moves to /docs/icons/usage/ and documents the six styles. Card links no
longer get the prose underline.

commits.author: sepantapouya
commits.subject: Icons: six variants built from the linear drawing
details: light, bold, bulk, two-tone, broken and curved. The build splits each
icon into closed shapes and details: bold fills shapes and cuts details
out with a mask, bulk fills shapes faintly, two-tone fades details,
broken opens a gap in each shape, curved rounds squircle frames further.
Exposed as the variant prop, iconSvg option, sprite ids and svg/<variant>/.

commits.author: sepantapouya
commits.subject: Docs: redesign the icons page and give every icon its own page
details: The icons page gets a spec strip, design principles, a sticky toolbar
with live size and stroke controls, and grid sections per category with
anchors. Each card links to /docs/icons/<name>/, which shows the icon on
its design grid, sizes, stroke control, copy and download, usage tabs,
related icons and prev/next links.

commits.author: sepantapouya
commits.subject: Docs: draw inline icons from @kashi-ui/icons
details: Header, code blocks, install box, gallery, hero panel, previews, demos and
site search used hand-drawn copies with the old 1.7 stroke. They now
render the package icons, so they follow the new soft style and stay in
sync with it.

commits.author: sepantapouya
commits.subject: Icons: changeset and rebuilt Figma plugin for the soft style

commits.author: sepantapouya
commits.subject: Icons: redraw commerce, identity and remaining interface icons
details: Rounded cart, tag and receipt; squircle inbox, id card, keyboard and
sidebar; softer plane, building, car and command.

commits.author: sepantapouya
commits.subject: Icons: redraw navigation, files and interface icons in the soft style
details: Softer pin, link, refresh, logout, folder and shield; squircle image and
grid; short sun rays, rounded moon tips, a curved two-star sparkle.

commits.author: sepantapouya
commits.subject: Icons: redraw dots, star, heart and finance icons in the soft style
details: Rounded-tip star, fuller heart, squircle card, wallet with a pocket,
chart bars inside a frame, and a softer bank roof.

commits.author: sepantapouya
commits.subject: Icons: redraw calendar through filter in the soft style
details: Squircle frames for calendar, mail, phone, lock and copy; closed soft
bodies for user and users; rounded house, bell, handset, file, trash,
pencil and funnel.

commits.author: sepantapouya
commits.subject: Icons: softer style, stroke 1.5; redraw status, actions and arrows
details: Add a squircle helper (continuous corners) for container shapes and lower
the default stroke from 1.7 to 1.5. Redraw info, success, warning, error,
close, check, chevrons, arrows, search, plus and minus.

commits.author: sepantapouya
commits.subject: Docs: enterprise redesign of the homepage, header and footer
details: Start-aligned hero with a spec sheet, package architecture diagram,
tabbed feature explorer with live demos, quality/CI section, comparison
table, and a calmer header and footer. Tabs now also move with Up/Down.

commits.author: sepantapouya
commits.subject: Release 0.16.0: @kashi-ui/icons

commits.author: sepantapouya
commits.subject: Docs header: add Icons; collapse nav into the menu below 64rem

commits.author: sepantapouya
commits.subject: Add @kashi-ui/icons and an icons page
details: New package with the 70 Kashi line icons (20x20 grid, 1.7 stroke), Persian
names and keywords in 11 categories: a React component per icon plus
<Icon name>, framework-free iconSvg()/searchIcons(), single SVG files and
a sprite. The Figma plugin now builds its icons from the same source.
/docs/icons/ lists every icon with search (Persian, English, Arabic
letters normalized), category filters and per-icon usage for React,
HTML, sprite, JavaScript, SVG file and Figma.

commits.author: sepantapouya
commits.subject: Docs: versions page built from git history and changelogs
details: scripts/releases.mjs groups every commit under the release that shipped
it (the next version bump), adds the changelog notes of all packages and
lists commits after the latest release as unreleased. It runs before dev
and build; on shallow clones (Vercel, CI) it keeps the committed data.
Linked from the footer and the docs sidebar.

commits.author: sepantapouya
commits.subject: Figma plugin: match every component to the live CSS
details: Every Figma part is tagged with its CSS class and compared with real
browser measurements (test/css-metrics.json): padding, radius, gap,
background, border and text colour, font size and weight, height.
268 classes / 1722 parts match with zero differences.
Rebuilt to the CSS: field labels/hints (1.35 line height), check text
(20px), options, tag input, number steps, OTP slots, dropzone and file
rows, calendar, month picker, segmented, alert icon rings, banner,
meter, empty state, popover, tour, dialog halo, stat card, table,
accordion, timeline, tree, kbd, tabs, breadcrumb, stepper numbers,
splitter, plate proportions, bank card gradient, bank badge in fields,
money, receipt, date tile and countdown.

commits.author: sepantapouya
commits.subject: Docs header: add Figma plugin and compare links

commits.author: sepantapouya
commits.subject: Figma plugin v2: one page per component, variables only, in-place updates
details: - Every component on its own page, grouped with page dividers
- No text or effect styles: text binds to typography variables and every
shadow layer binds to theme variables (colour, offset, blur, spread)
- Re-running in the same file updates components in place (same node ids),
adds new ones and keeps instances and text overrides linked
- Variants laid out in a labelled grid (state columns, variant/size rows)
- Matches measured CSS: badge heights, alert/card surfaces, checkbox and chip
shadows, dialog shadow, tooltip height; 61 parity checks in the test
- Fixes palette overflow, URL field, combobox two-line options, docs links
- Author photo on the cover; downloadable zip and a Figma plugin docs page

commits.author: sepantapouya
commits.subject: Figma plugin: make the source manifest importable too

commits.author: sepantapouya
commits.subject: Add Kashi UI Kit Figma plugin
details: Builds Kashi in Figma from the real tokens: ~200 variables (theme, radius,
density, spacing, typography modes), 44 text styles, effect styles, 70 icons,
50 bank logos and 73 RTL component sets with ~726 variants. Tested in a strict
mock of the Figma plugin API (npm run figma:test), also run in CI.

commits.author: Sepanta Pouya
commits.subject: Merge Persian field pages into one PersianInput page
details: PersianInput gains time and plate kinds, covering eleven field types.
The separate docs pages for each field are folded into sections of
the PersianInput page, and their old URLs redirect to the matching
section. The menu and Persian gallery list the merged field once.

commits.author: Sepanta Pouya
commits.subject: Kashi 0.15: PersianInput and new Persian components
details: PersianInput puts national ID, company ID, mobile, landline, card,
Sheba, amount, postal code and text into one field chosen by kind.
New components: LegalIdInput, KeyboardFixInput (suggests «سلام» for
"sghl"), PersianTextarea (Arabic letters, half-spaces, punctuation
and digits), Money, BankCard, PaymentReceipt and DateTile. The
persian package gains isValidLegalId, fixKeyboardLayout,
looksLikeWrongLayout, fixPersianText, formatMoney, rialToToman and
tomanToRial. Each has a docs page and a gallery card.

commits.author: Sepanta Pouya
commits.subject: Add social preview image and promo artwork page
details: og:image and twitter:card point to a 1200x630 image rendered from real
Kashi components; /promo (noindex) regenerates it and the 16:9 post.

commits.author: Sepanta Pouya
commits.subject: Reword donation text

commits.author: Sepanta Pouya

details: Explains that Kashi is free but costly to build, and invites donations
via Telegram (@sepantapouya_ux).

notes.text: کامپوننت‌های فارسی تازه: PersianInput (یک فیلد برای کد ملی، شبا، کارت، مبلغ، کد پستی، موبایل، تلفن، ساعت، پلاک و متن با `kind`)، LegalIdInput (شناسهٔ ملی شرکت با رقم کنترل)، KeyboardFixInput (پیشنهاد «سلام» برای «sghl»)، PersianTextarea (ویرایش نگارشی: «ي/ك» عربی، نیم‌فاصله، علامت‌ها و ارقام)، Money (تومان و ریال، حالت خلاصه و مبلغ به حروف برای صفحه‌خوان)، BankCard (کارت بانکی با رنگ و لوگوی بانک)، PaymentReceipt (رسید پرداخت) و DateTile (برگ تقویم شمسی با مناسبت). ابزارهای تازه در `@kashi-ui/persian`: `isValidLegalId`، `fixKeyboardLayout`، `looksLikeWrongLayout`، `fixPersianText`، `formatMoney`، `rialToToman` و `tomanToRial`.

commits.author: Sepanta Pouya
commits.subject: Kashi 0.14: MultiSelect, sliding tab indicator, pagination tools
details: New MultiSelect with search, chips and a selection cap. Tabs indicator
slides in all variants including vertical. Pagination gains page size
selection and a jump-to-page field. DatePicker and DateRangePicker
forward holidays to the calendar.

notes.text: بهبود کامپوننت‌ها: کامپوننت تازهٔ MultiSelect (انتخاب چندتایی با جستجو، برچسب و سقف انتخاب). نشانگر Tabs در هر سه گونه و حالت عمودی با تغییر زبانه می‌لغزد. Pagination فهرست «در هر صفحه» (`pageSize`، `onPageSizeChange`) و فیلد «برو به صفحه» (`jumper`) گرفت. DatePicker و DateRangePicker حالا `holidays` را به تقویم می‌دهند.

commits.author: Sepanta Pouya
commits.subject: Custom color panel; accurate Farsi UI comparison
details: ColorPicker opens Kashi's own panel (saturation area, hue slider,
eyedropper, RGB fields) instead of the native browser picker. The
comparison page now reflects Farsi UI from its repository and docs:
Jalali calendar, Persian inputs, Vazirmatn, 500+ components and blocks.

notes.text: ColorPicker حالا پنل انتخاب اختصاصی کاشی دارد به‌جای انتخابگر بومی مرورگر: سطح اشباع و روشنایی با موس و کیبورد، نوار رنگ‌مایه، قطره‌چکان (در مرورگرهای پشتیبان) و فیلدهای R، G و B.

commits.author: Sepanta Pouya
commits.subject: Kashi 0.13: carousel, color picker, tour, meter, splitter, holidays
details: Calendar marks Fridays and Iran's fixed official holidays, with lunar
holidays supplied per year. Docs gain a comparison page against Farsi
UI, shadcn/ui, MUI and Ant Design, with a homepage teaser, and a fixed
activity heatmap preview.

notes.text: کامپوننت‌های تازه: Carousel (روی scroll-snap بومی، بدون چرخش خودکار)، ColorPicker (با کنتراست متن و `contrastRatio`)، Tour (راهنمای قدم‌به‌قدم)، Meter (`role="meter"` با آستانهٔ هشدار) و Splitter (پنل‌های قابل‌تغییر اندازه با کیبورد). Calendar حالا `holidays` می‌گیرد و جمعه‌ها و تعطیلات رسمی را قرمز و با نام نشان می‌دهد؛ `getIranHoliday` و `IRAN_FIXED_HOLIDAYS` در `@kashi-ui/persian`. رفع رنگ تیک نمونه‌رنگ‌ها.

commits.author: Sepanta Pouya
commits.subject: Kashi 0.12: charts, heatmap, context menu, inline edit, province select
details: BarChart (single and stacked), LineChart, PieChart, BarList,

details: New homepage with live product panel, scroll motion, marquee, animated

glass header, TOC scrollspy and refreshed footer. Motion respects

commits.author: Sepanta Pouya

and tabs, and single-letter initials on small avatars.

notes.text: ظاهر حرفه‌ای‌تر: رنگ برند در تم تیره پررنگ‌تر با متن سفید، خاکستری‌های تیره کم‌رنگ‌مایه‌تر، ارقام فارسی با عرض طبیعی در همهٔ کامپوننت‌ها (جدول، صفحه‌بندی، پیشرفت، ورودی و تقویم)، هشدار و زبانه‌ها تمام‌عرض، و آواتار کوچک تک‌حرفی.
ارتفاع فیلد، انتخاب از فهرست و ورودی برچسب با دکمه یکی شد (۳۶، ۴۰ و ۴۴ پیکسل) تا در یک ردیف هم‌قد باشند. دکمه‌ها حالت فشرده و چک‌باکس و رادیوی انتخاب‌شده حالت hover گرفتند.

commits.author: Sepanta Pouya
commits.subject: Kashi 0.9: eleven new components
details: Combobox, CommandPalette, TagInput, FileUpload, Slider, NumberInput,
Popover, Jalali DateRangePicker with presets, StatCard/StatGrid,
Timeline and SideNav, with docs pages, demos and tests. Calendar gains
range selection with hover preview. Docs demos no longer clip popups.

commits.author: Sepanta Pouya
commits.subject: Fix circular progress spin jump; remove duplicated CSS blocks
details: The indeterminate ring rotated the svg, which already had a -90deg base
rotation, so each loop jumped 90 degrees. Spin the container instead.
Also remove rule blocks that an earlier edit duplicated into
forced-colors and reduced-motion sections (avatar, input, progress).

notes.text: ۱۱ کامپوننت تازه: Combobox (جستجو با یکدست‌سازی فارسی)، CommandPalette (Ctrl+K)، TagInput، FileUpload (کشیدن و رها کردن با پیشرفت)، Slider (تکی و بازه)، NumberInput، Popover، DateRangePicker شمسی با میان‌برها، StatCard و StatGrid، Timeline و SideNav. Calendar حالا بازه را با پیش‌نمایش نشان می‌دهد.

رفع پرش انیمیشن Progress دایره‌ایِ نامعین (چرخش حالا روی ظرف است، نه svg)، و حذف قواعد تکراری‌ای که به اشتباه داخل بخش‌های forced-colors و prefers-reduced-motion کپی شده بودند (avatar، input، progress).

commits.author: Sepanta Pouya
commits.subject: Kashi 0.8: deep customization for every component
details: classNames slots and data-state attributes, 93 component CSS variables,
and new options across Button, Input, Textarea, Badge, Avatar, Card,
Alert, Tabs, Dialog (drawer and sheet), Toast (placements, promise),
Tooltip, DataTable, Progress (circular), DropdownMenu and Switch.
Fixes duplicate toasts with multiple Toasters and exports CardMedia.

commits.author: Sepanta Pouya
commits.subject: Redesign Breadcrumb; keep docs link color below kashi layers
details: The docs' base link color was unlayered, so it beat every component's
link styles (breadcrumb links all brand-colored). It now lives in a
site-base layer declared before kashi. Breadcrumb gets neutral links,
a distinct current page, icon-only items, collapsing with focus
handoff, a slash separator and truncation.

notes.text: ارتقای شخصی‌سازی همهٔ کامپوننت‌ها:
sub: **پایه:** `classNames` برای استایل هر بخش داخلی (Input، Textarea، Checkbox، Switch، Alert، DataTable)، ویژگی‌های `data-variant`/`data-size`/`data-tone`/`data-state`/`data-placement` و ۹۳ متغیر CSS در سطح کامپوننت.
**Button:** رندر به‌صورت لینک با `href`، کامپوننت دلخواه با `as` (مثل Link در Next.js)، `shape` (pill/square) و اندازهٔ `xs`.
**Input/Textarea:** نمایش و پنهان کردن رمز، `clearable`، `loading`، `showCount`، `optional`، `labelEnd` و ارتفاع خودکار.
**Badge:** سبک‌های `solid` و `outline`، آیکون و `onRemove`. **Avatar:** رنگ خودکار ثابت از روی نام.
**Card:** سبک‌های `elevated` و `filled`، `padding`، `CardMedia` و `actions` در سربرگ. **Alert:** `layout="banner"` و `size="sm"`.
**Tabs:** جهت عمودی و اندازهٔ `sm`. **Dialog:** کشوی کناری و برگهٔ پایین با `placement`. **Tooltip:** جایگاه‌های start و end.
**Toast:** شش جایگاه، `max`، به‌روزرسانی با `id` و `toast.promise`؛ با چند Toaster در صفحه، اعلان‌ها دیگر تکراری نمی‌شوند.
**DataTable:** راه‌راه، سرستون ثابت، ردیف‌های بارگذاری، کلیک روی ردیف، `footer`، چینش و پنهان شدن ستون در موبایل.

commits.author: Sepanta Pouya
commits.subject: Kashi 0.7: twelve more components
details: DropdownMenu (WAI-ARIA menu button), DataTable (Persian collation sort,
row selection, numeric columns), OtpInput (single real input with SMS
autofill), Accordion on native details, Stepper, Pagination, Breadcrumb,
Progress and Spinner, Skeleton, EmptyState, Divider and Kbd, each with
docs, live demos and accessibility tests.

notes.text: Breadcrumb بازطراحی شد: لینک‌های خنثی، صفحهٔ فعلی با پس‌زمینهٔ ملایم، فاصلهٔ آیکون و متن، `hideLabel` برای نمایش فقط آیکون (مثل خانه)، `maxItems` برای جمع کردن مسیرهای بلند به «…» (با انتقال فوکوس پس از باز شدن)، `separator="slash"` و کوتاه شدن نام‌های بلند.

۱۲ کامپوننت جدید: DropdownMenu (الگوی Menu Button با پیمایش کامل کیبورد)، DataTable (مرتب‌سازی الفبای فارسی، انتخاب ردیف‌ها، ستون‌های عددی)، OtpInput (کد تأیید با یک input واقعی و پر شدن خودکار پیامک)، Accordion روی details بومی، Stepper، Pagination با ارقام فارسی، Breadcrumb، Progress و Spinner، Skeleton، EmptyState، Divider و Kbd.

commits.author: Sepanta Pouya
commits.subject: Release swappable fonts as 0.6.0
details: 0.5.0 was already published before the font work landed, so its
changelog wrongly listed it. Font changes now ship as 0.6.0.

commits.author: Sepanta Pouya
commits.subject: Swappable fonts: createTheme font options, font-face helper, no-font CSS

fontFamily, displayFontFamily, monoFontFamily, textScale and fonts
(@font-face for self-hosted files). New --k-font-display and

a live font picker for nine free OFL Persian fonts.

commits.author: Sepanta Pouya
commits.subject: Fold radio name fix into the unreleased 0.5.0 changelog

commits.author: Sepanta Pouya
commits.subject: Fix radios in docs allowing multiple selection; avatar group max
details: MDX renders React children separately, so RadioGroup and AvatarGroup
context never reached them: radios had no shared name and AvatarGroup
showed every avatar. Demos now render whole groups in React. Radio also
accepts name directly and warns in development when it has none.

commits.author: Sepanta Pouya
commits.subject: Fix docs link color overriding link-buttons; document the layer pitfall
details: The site's global a {} rule beat .k-btn (unlayered beats layered), so the
primary 'Get started' link-button had brand text on a brand background.

notes.text: فونت قابل‌تعویض: `createTheme` حالا `fontFamily`، `displayFontFamily`، `monoFontFamily`، `textScale` و `fonts` (برای @font-face فونت‌های خودمیزبان، از جمله فونت‌های خریداری‌شده) می‌پذیرد؛ توابع جدید `fontFace` و `fontStack`؛ توکن‌های `--k-font-display` (فونت عنوان‌ها) و `--k-text-scale` (ضریب اندازهٔ متن)؛ و فایل `@kashi-ui/css/kashi.nofont.css` بدون وزیرمتن برای کسانی که فونت دیگری استفاده می‌کنند.

commits.author: Sepanta Pouya
commits.subject: Kashi 0.5: core interactive components and visual polish
details: - New: RadioGroup (list, inline, cards), Select on native select, Tabs
(line, pill, segmented) following WAI-ARIA, Dialog on native dialog
with focus return, Toast with pause-on-hover and toast() API, Tooltip
meeting WCAG 1.4.13, RelativeTime and formatRelative
- Polish: vivid dark-mode primary with dark text, lightest borders that
still meet 3:1, dark-mode surface highlight and visible shadows,
tabular digits, input hover, iOS focus-zoom fix, text-on-error token
- Docs: six new component pages; prose styles no longer leak into demos

notes.text: کامپوننت‌های جدید: RadioGroup و Radio (با سبک کارت)، Select، Tabs (سه سبک)، Dialog روی dialog بومی، Toast با `toast()`، Tooltip و RelativeTime. ابزار جدید `formatRelative` برای زمان نسبی فارسی.
`Radio` حالا `name` را مستقیم هم می‌پذیرد و اگر بیرون از `RadioGroup` و بدون `name` استفاده شود، در حالت توسعه هشدار می‌دهد (بدون name مشترک، چند گزینه هم‌زمان قابل‌انتخاب بود).
